aboutPage.title: About Me
aboutPage.metaDescription: Daniel Zotti: software engineer and creative performer in Trieste.
aboutPage.subtitle: Software Engineer & Creative Performer in Trieste.
aboutPage.description1: If you are looking for a traditional, code-confined software engineer in Trieste, Italy, you might be in the wrong place.
aboutPage.description2End: convinced that life should be lived firsthand and that the only way to grow is to constantly challenge myself.
aboutPage.quote: ✨ Here is what drives my creativity and everyday life when I am not writing production-ready code. ✨
aboutPage.stageSectionIntro: The stage is my best training ground for stress management, public speaking, and rapid problem solving. Every show sharpens the same skills I bring to software engineering.
aboutPage.theatreImprovisationText: Since 2022, I have been actively practicing theatre improvisation in Trieste with Improvvisamente Trieste APS: a fantastic association that keeps me present, reactive, and fully connected with people.
aboutPage.standUpComedyText: I am an active performer and host in Gin Comici, presenting comedians and delivering original monologues across FVG venues.
aboutPage.murderMysteryDinnersText: I collaborate as an actor with Gli Indiziosi, blending theatre and immersive audience interaction to solve mysteries between dinner courses.
aboutPage.airBandChampionText: Alongside my group Ban Halen, I won the historic 2012 Air Band Contest at Round Midnight / Stazione Rogers with epic mash-ups.
aboutPage.creativeLabIntro: My technical background has always been fueled by artistic curiosity. In my digital lab I mix code, visuals, and storytelling to create interactive experiences.
aboutPage.musicFirstText: My creative roots started at age 3 when I started playing the piano with my grandmom, and music is still the soundtrack of my life. At university, I even played in a rock band made entirely of software and electronic engineers.
aboutPage.videoProductionText: From VHS editing in middle school to Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, visual storytelling has always been part of my toolkit.
aboutPage.creativeCodeText: I build playful digital experiments like the Meteoropathic Website, the Fake 3D Website, and Slide Roulette.
aboutPage.podcastingText: I co-host Shiftati di Testa with Stefano, discussing tech, culture, and odd life questions.
aboutPage.triestineHeartIntro: Trieste is part of my identity. I love local traditions that blend irony, community spirit, and a healthy dose of playful madness.
aboutPage.olimpiadeDelleClanfeText: Olimpiade dele Clanfe is a historic and eccentric water-splashing and diving competition in Trieste, where the biggest splash and funniest sketch take the crown.
aboutPage.rampigataSantaText: Rampigada Santa is a grueling 2 km vertical uphill race in Trieste that I complete on foot, often handing out cold beers for moral support along the way.
aboutPage.muggiaCarnivalText: I join Muggia's traditional Carnival with satirical costumes inspired by current events, and I am also guilty of participating in pop-powered flashmobs in downtown Trieste.
aboutPage.inVentoText: In 2017, I won the InVento Trieste competition by designing the city tourism logo, slogan "We are inTRIESTEing", and promotional video.
aboutPage.eventsIntro: I enjoy designing events that connect people and create memorable moments. Sports, games, and collective experiences are a natural extension of how I work and live.
aboutPage.giuochiSenzaSperanzaText: An annual goliardic multi-sport tournament (from basketball to beer pong) that I founded in 2018 to celebrate my first 10,000 days of life.
aboutPage.improboraFestivalText: ImproBora is a theatre improvisation festival in Trieste that I've co-organized since 2025: workshops led by international teachers, dinners in beautiful locations, amazing shows, with a touch of "morbin".
aboutPage.corporateTeamBuildingText: I designed engaging event formats such as Fortigames (a multi-sport company tournament) and Fortitudex (an interactive Pokemon-style corporate game) for Fortitude Group.
aboutPage.sportsAndFitnessText: After 20+ years of competitive soccer with Esperia and a 2-year stint in table tennis, I now keep fit with walks through Trieste on my way to the office, brainstorming new ideas and thinking about life (and ice creams).

asciiSmuggler.title: ASCII Smuggler
asciiSmuggler.description: Convert ASCII text to invisible Unicode Tag Characters or decode hidden messages
asciiSmuggler.jsonLdDescription: A security utility to encode invisible Unicode Tag Characters or detect and decode hidden payloads to prevent indirect LLM prompt injections.
asciiSmuggler.decodePlaceholder: Paste the text here to search for hidden payloads...
asciiSmuggler.decodedPlaceholder: Decoded text with hidden tags shown...
asciiSmuggler.secretText: Secret Text to Smuggle (Will be hidden at the end)
asciiSmuggler.secretPlaceholder: Enter secret message to hide here...
asciiSmuggler.preview: Concatenated Preview (Hidden text is embedded and invisible):
asciiSmuggler.whatIsText: ASCII Smuggling is a technique that hides text within Unicode characters that do not render visually in standard fonts. Specifically, it uses characters from the Unicode Tags Block (U+E0000–U+E007F), which map 1:1 to the standard ASCII character set.
asciiSmuggler.why: Why is it a security issue?
asciiSmuggler.injection: Indirect Prompt Injection: An attacker can embed hidden instructions on a webpage or within a document. When a Large Language Model (LLM) parses the page, the model's tokenizer decodes these characters and processes the hidden instructions, while a human reading the same page sees only the benign text.
asciiSmuggler.exfiltration: Data Exfiltration: Sensitive information could be encoded as invisible characters and smuggled out of a secure environment past data loss prevention (DLP) systems.
asciiSmuggler.defenseText: Sanitize all inputs processed by LLMs or rendering engines. Ensure that characters within the Unicode Tags block (U+E0000 to U+E007F) are stripped out or neutralized before processing.
